title: Melbourne Traffic Congestion Forecasting Assistant
author: Qizhe Yew
scenario: In a smart city context, commuters and transport planners need timely insight into when and where congestion is likely to occur. This use case combines Melbourne transport activity counts, historical microclimate data, and optional live weather values to predict whether a selected sensor location will experience Low, Medium, or High congestion.
description: This use case builds a Melbourne traffic congestion forecasting assistant using Transport Activity Count data, microclimate data, machine learning classification, LLM explanation, RAG, and a Streamlit map UI.
